intro: Clothes that fit or not, what happens to them in the wash, and the vocabulary of paying and complaining.
p.cremallera.consejo: The «ll» sounds like «y»: «kre-ma-YE-ra». You pull it up and down.
p.botón.consejo: It is also the button on a device, which you press. The plural, «botones», has no accent.
p.estampado.consejo: The opposite is «liso». There are fabrics «estampadas» with flowers or other designs.
p.dar de sí.consejo: It is the opposite of «encoger». A woollen jumper often «da de sí».
p.pasado de moda.consejo: The opposite is «estar de moda». It agrees: «una chaqueta pasada de moda».
p.coser.consejo: It is not «cocer», which is cooking. In Spain «coser» has an s sound and «cocer» a th.
p.descosido.consejo: It comes from «coser»: «des-» undoes the action. A seam «se descose».
p.al contado.consejo: You pay everything at once. The opposite is «a plazos».
p.a plazos.consejo: A «plazo» is each part of the payment. You can pay a fridge or a car «a plazos».
p.señal.consejo: The «ñ» sounds «ny»: «se-NYAL». It also means a sign or a signal.
p.factura.consejo: It helps you complain. With the «factura» you can ask for an exchange or a refund.
p.consumidor.consejo: It comes from «consumir». Consumers have a right to a guarantee, exchange and refund.
p.hoja de reclamaciones.consejo: In Spain every business must have one. You ask for it like this: «una hoja de reclamaciones, por favor».
b1.titulo: How it fits, how it is cared for and how it is paid
b1.texto:
**How it fits.** **Quedar** + adjective works like **gustar**: **me queda apretado**, **me quedan grandes**. **Me sienta bien** means it suits me.

**What happens to clothes.** A garment **encoge** in the wash or **da de sí** with use. A seam **se descose** and you **cose** it with needle and thread. Fabric can be plain or **estampada**. If it is no longer worn, it is **pasada de moda**.

**Parts.** **La cremallera**, **los botones**, **el bolsillo**, **la manga**.

**How you pay.** **Al contado** (all at once) or **a plazos** (a part each month). To reserve something, you leave **una señal**. You ask for **la factura** or the receipt.

**How you complain.** The **consumidor** has rights: guarantee, exchange and refund. If there is no solution, you ask for **la hoja de reclamaciones**.
b2.f0.texto: I bought this jacket a week ago.
b2.f1.texto: When I washed it, it shrank two sizes.
b2.f2.texto: The label says it has to be taken to the dry cleaner's.
b2.f3.texto: The button was already coming loose.
b2.f4.texto: If you have the invoice, I can exchange it for another one.
b2.f5.texto: I paid for it in cash and kept the receipt.
b2.f6.texto: I am sorry, but I cannot give you your money back.
b2.f7.texto: If you like, I will bring you the complaints form.
b2.f8.texto: Then I want to make a complaint about this product.
b4.titulo: Quedar, dar de sí and «preferiría que…»
b4.texto:
**Quedar + adjective** says how a garment fits you. It agrees with the garment, not with you: **este abrigo me queda grande**, **estos pantalones me quedan apretados**.

**Encoger and dar de sí** tell what happens to clothes. With the present perfect: **ha encogido**, **ha dado de sí**.

**Preferiría que + imperfect subjunctive** is a very polite way to ask: **preferiría que me devolvieran el dinero**, **preferiría que me lo cambiaran**.

The imperfect subjunctive of **devolver** is **devolviera**, **devolvieras**, **devolviera**, **devolviéramos**, **devolvierais**, **devolvieran**.
b4.e0.texto: These trousers are tight on me.
b4.e1.texto: The jumper has stretched in the washing machine.
b4.e2.texto: I would prefer you to give me my money back.
b5.titulo: The fitting room and the needle
b5.f0.texto: In the fitting room, the yellow light falls on a tired mirror.
b5.f1.texto: Lucía puts on a jacket patterned with blue and red flowers.
b5.f2.texto: The zip goes up with a dry click as far as the collar.
b5.f3.texto: The sleeves are too long on her and cover her hands.
b5.f4.texto: She looks at herself for a moment, frowns and leaves the garment on the hanger.
b5.f5.texto: At home, grandmother threads a needle under the kitchen lamp.
b5.f6.texto: She picks up the loose button and sews it on slowly with blue thread.
b5.f7.texto: Her hands, wrinkled like old paper, do not tremble for a single second.
b5.f8.texto: In the end, the jacket fastens well and smells of clean soap.
b5.f9.texto: Through the window, the evening comes in slowly and paints the fabric orange.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «pantalones» is plural, so «quedan» is needed.
b6.o1.refuerzo: It is singular; «pantalones» needs a plural.
b6.o2.refuerzo: To say how a garment fits you, «quedar» is used.
b7.o0.refuerzo: That is paying everything at once.
b7.o1.refuerzo: Yes: each part of the payment is a plazo.
b7.o2.refuerzo: The señal is a deposit to reserve, not payment over months.
b7.pregunta: You pay a little each month. How do you pay?
b8.frase: Quiero poner una reclamación por este producto
b8.traduccion: I want to make a complaint about this product
b9.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «dar de sí» is becoming wider or longer with use.
b9.o1.refuerzo: Encoger is the opposite: becoming smaller.
b9.o2.refuerzo: Descoserse is a seam opening; the size does not change.
b9.pregunta: What has a jumper done that is now bigger?
b11.o0.refuerzo: It is indicative. After «preferiría que» comes the subjunctive.
b11.o1.refuerzo: It is the future indicative, not the subjunctive.
b11.o2.refuerzo: Yes: «preferiría que» needs the imperfect subjunctive.
b12.o0.refuerzo: Instalments are agreed when paying; the form is not for that.
b12.o1.refuerzo: The señal is left in the shop to reserve something.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Yes: it is the official paper for complaining about a business.
b12.pregunta: What is the complaints form for?
p.lavarla.consejo: «la» refers to a feminine noun like «la prenda». «lavarla» means to wash it.
p.encogido.consejo: «encogido» comes from «encoger», to shrink. The «g» before «i» sounds like «j»: en-ko-SI-do.
p.tallas.consejo: «talla» is feminine: «la talla». The «ll» is pronounced «y»: TA-yas.
p.llevarla.consejo: Here «la» refers to a feminine item. «llevarla» means to take it somewhere.
p.tinte.consejo: «el tinte» is masculine. The «ti» sounds like «ti» in «tip»: TIN-te.
p.cambiársela.glosa: to exchange it for you (infinitive with «se la»)
p.cambiársela.consejo: «se» replaces «le» before «la». The accent on «cambiár-» keeps the stress on «ÁR».
p.pagué.consejo: The accent on «pagué» marks the stress at the end: pa-GE. «gu» before «e» sounds «ge».
p.guardé.consejo: «guardar» means to keep. The accent on «guardé» marks the last syllable: gwar-DE.
p.producto.consejo: «producto» is masculine: «el producto». The «c» before «t» sounds like «k».
p.apretados.consejo: «apretado» means tight. It agrees with «pantalones», which is masculine plural.
p.devolvieran.consejo: The «ie» diphthong is one sound. It follows an idea of wish or doubt.
p.estampada.consejo: «estampado» is a printed pattern. The feminine form «estampada» agrees with «chaqueta».
p.chasquido.consejo: «chasquido» is masculine: «el chasquido». The «ch» is pronounced as in «church».
p.cuello.consejo: «cuello» is masculine: «el cuello». The «ll» is «y»: KWE-yo.
p.mangas.consejo: «manga» is feminine: «la manga». The «g» before «a» is hard: MAN-gas.
p.frunce.consejo: «frunce el ceño» means to frown. The «c» before «e» sounds «th» in Spain.
p.prenda.consejo: «prenda» is feminine: «la prenda». It is any single piece of clothing.
p.enhebra.consejo: «enhebrar» means to thread a needle. The «h» is silent: en-E-bra.
p.aguja.consejo: «aguja» is feminine: «la aguja». The «j» is pronounced like a strong «h»: a-GU-ha.
p.coge.consejo: «coger» means to pick up. The «g» before «e» sounds like a strong «h»: KO-he.
p.cose.consejo: «coser» is to sew. It sounds similar to «coger» but means a different action.
p.quejarte.consejo: «quejarte» means to complain. The «j» sounds like «h»: ke-HAR-te.
p.oficialmente.consejo: Adverbs in «-mente» add «-mente» to the adjective: «oficial» becomes «oficialmente».
